Model.Name: FuneralModelReporting
Model.Notes: Reporting model layer - contains the user defined output required for reporting. Output can be selected from any other sub-model layer.

Input.Name: Policy
Input.Notes: Serves as the root folder or container for all policy-related input fields and values.

Input.Name: ProductName
Input.Notes: Stores the official name or identifier of the insurance product linked to the policy.

Formula.Name: API
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.PolicyStatus = "Paid Up" Then Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Premium * SMCoreModel.PremiumFrequency * Healthy_PRO(t) End If

Formula.Name: Accidental_Mortality_Fam_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to accidental death for family members. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to accidental death and AIDS.

Formula.Name: Accidental_Mortality_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to accidental death. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to accidental death and AIDS.

Formula.Name: AcquisitionAAW_func
Formula.Notes: This function calculates the inflation-adjusted acquisition expense at time t scaled by a sensitivity factor

Formula.Name: Critical_Illness_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to critical illness. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to critical illness and AIDS.

Formula.Name: Healthy_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of healthy policies remaining at each time step. It subtracts all decrements (like lapses, mortality, disability, etc.) and maturity from the previous period's healthy policies, ensuring the result is not negative, and adjusts for bullet lapses.

Formula.Name: InceptionYRCohort
Formula.Value: If CoverStartDate().Year <= 2020 Then Return 2020 Else Return CoverStartDate().Year End If

Formula.Name: Lapses_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that lapse in a given month. It uses the previous month's healthy policies and applies a monthly lapse rate, adjusted for AIDS-related mortality if applicable.

Formula.Name: Maturity_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that mature when only one month remains. It subtracts all other decrements from the previous month's healthy policies.

Formula.Name: Mortality_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to mortality. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to mortality and AIDS.

Formula.Name: Natural_Mortality_Fam_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to natural mortality for family members. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to natural mortality and AIDS.

Formula.Name: Natural_Mortality_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to natural mortality. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to natural mortality and AIDS.

Formula.Name: Permanent_Disability_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to permanent disability. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to permanent disability and AIDS.

Formula.Name: Retrenchment_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to retrenchment. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to retrenchment and AIDS.

Formula.Name: Temporary_Disability_PRO
Formula.Notes: This formula calculates the number of policies that end due to temporary disability. It uses the previous period's healthy policies and applies a monthly probability of decrement due to temporary disability and AIDS.

Formula.Name: Terminal_Illness_PRO
Formula.Notes: This function calculates the probability of terminal illness for a given month. If the month is less than or equal to 0 or the terminal illness declaration is 0, it returns 0. Otherwise, it calculates the probability based on the healthy probability of the previous month and the decrement functions for terminal illness and AIDS.

Formula.Name: X_Clawback_Cover
Formula.Value: If X_CommClaw_CF(t) <> 0 Then Return - 1 * X_CommClaw_CF(t) / SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t)
